summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by updating the regular expression to support language codes with scripts and regions, but it may not cover all valid BCP 47 language tags.

issues.description: The regular expression update may not cover all valid BCP 47 language tags, such as those with variants, extensions, or private use subtags.
The regular expression uses non-standard naming conventions for capturing groups, which might be inconsistent with Django's style guidelines.
